definitions.explanation: A glassy coating fused onto metal, and the pots, kettles and tubs made that way. Also written {琺瑯|ほうろう}.

examples.japanese: ホーロー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧だ。
ホーロー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やかん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧。
examples.english: I boil water in an enamel kettle.

examples.japanese: ホーロー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧におい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{移|うつ}り→移る：01232_utsuru⟧にくい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Enamel containers don't absorb smells easily, so they're good for storing pickles.

notes:
The katakana spelling is the usual one on product labels; the kanji {琺瑯|ほうろう} is rare. Valued in the kitchen because it does not rust or hold smells, though it chips if dropped.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ホーロー⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: an enamel pot
- ホーロー⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of enamel
- ホーロー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浴槽|よくそう}→浴槽：04985_yokusou⟧: an enamel bathtub

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ステンレス→ステンレス：08832_sutenresu⟧: stainless steel
- {鋳物|いもの}: cast iron (ware)
